race.title: Olly Murphy Proudly Sponsored By Betano 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
race.verdict: FRIENDLY GLANCE was quite a taking winner of his Doncaster bumper and he's fancied to make a successful start over hurdles that features several interesting debutants to this sphere, with Power of Silence and L'Unique Allen chief amongst them. FRIENDLY GLANCE POWER OF SILENCE (IRE) L'UNIQUE ALLEN (FR)
race.bettingForecast: St Gabriel (11/4), Friendly Glance (3/1), L'unique Allen (7/2), Power Of Silence (6/1), Artaban (7/1), Prince Vinny (10/1), Sub Editor (20/1), Elmsford (25/1), Twentysixsoldiers (33/1), For Her Glory (50/1), Golden Sanjida (50/1), All Good To Go (66/1), Roxy Rocks (66/1), Our Rarest Hour (66/1), Triple Edge (100/1)
